Name: Amusement Park
Author: Jinjin1221
Description:
I've made AMUSEMENT PARK in stardew valley.

You need ﻿SMAPI and TMX Loader ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820 ).

Download the TMX Loader and [TMX]AmusementPark.

Put the files in the mod file.

And please do not open up the [TMX]AmusementPark file.


The tunnel which is next to the bus stop, get in there and there will be a crystal.
If you touch the crystal, you can go to AMUSEMENT PARK..!

I've no time to make the ride the things..
But someday.. If I have time, I'll get some people and make you guys ride the merry-go-round or stuffs like that.
